fixes.explanation: That sounds like a decent plan, but it's not what Abraham says. His words are, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” He doesn't say what they'll find up there. He says who will provide. I think that's a lot to carry up a mountain, and he keeps walking.

Resent is a different word, and the angel never says it. He says, “…now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.” The angel gives a reason for what he now knows: Abraham didn't hold back his only son. Fear here is about honoring God, and that's what Abraham showed (Gen 22:12). Nothing in the verse says Abraham was bitter. I'm not going to put that on him.
